```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


## Import Data 
```{r Import data}

# import SVI Dataset
SVI <- read.csv("data/NORTHCAROLINA_COUNTY.csv", header=TRUE)

# SVI data dimensions 
nrow(SVI)
ncol(SVI)
dim(SVI)

# import FEMA claims dataset 
FEMA_claims_data <- read.csv("data/FEMA_filtered.csv", header=TRUE)

#FEMA data dimensions
nrow(FEMA_claims_data)
ncol(FEMA_claims_data)
dim(FEMA_claims_data)

```

## Filter Data 
```{r Filter data}

# install.packages("dplyr") install dplyr package if needed 
library(dplyr) # load dpylr package 

# filter SVI data for variables of interest 
SVI_filtered <- SVI %>% select(COUNTY, FIPS, AREA_SQMI, E_TOTPOP, M_TOTPOP, E_HU, M_HU, E_HH, 
                               M_HH, RPL_THEME1, RPL_THEME2, RPL_THEME3, RPL_THEME4, RPL_THEMES)
dim(SVI_filtered) #dimensions of filtered SVI data


# filter FEMA data for variables of interest 
FEMA_claims_data_filtered <- FEMA_claims_data %>% select(dateOfLoss, ratedFloodZone,
                                                    numberOfFloorsInTheInsuredBuilding,
                                                    amountPaidOnBuildingClaim,
                                                    amountPaidOnIncreasedCostOfComplianceClaim,
                                                    totalBuildingInsuranceCoverage, 
                                                    buildingDamageAmount, 
                                                    netBuildingPaymentAmount, buildingPropertyValue,
                                                    numberOfUnits, countyCode)
dim(FEMA_claims_data_filtered) #dimensions of filtered FEMA data

```

## Join Data 
```{r Join data}

# create master dataset, joining the two datasets by their county code ID (FIPS)
master_FEMA_SVI_data <- full_join(FEMA_claims_data_filtered, SVI_filtered,
  by = c("countyCode" = "FIPS")
)
dim(master_FEMA_SVI_data) #dimensions of final dataset

# creating CSV of master data set and adding it to data processed folder 
write.csv(master_FEMA_SVI_data, "data/processed/master_FEMA_SVI_data.csv")

```
